# mdfm

> `jq` for Markdown frontmatter: single-binary Rust CLI for querying, mutating, deleting, and validating YAML (`---`) and TOML (`+++`) frontmatter without modifying the Markdown body.

`mdfm` operates on byte offsets so Markdown bodies, UTF-8 BOMs, `LF`/`CRLF` line endings, closing delimiters (`---` vs `...`), and untouched slices survive edits verbatim. TOML frontmatter is mutated losslessly via `toml_edit` to preserve comments, formatting, and key order. Supports dot-path queries, `--where` filtering, typed value parsing, `--dry-run` previews, `.gitignore`-aware directory walking, and pure-Rust JSON Schema validation across Linux, macOS, and Windows.

---

## Overview & Key Invariants

- **Byte-Exact Body Preservation:** Never splits or reconstructs Markdown bodies with `str::lines()`. Uses byte offsets to preserve UTF-8 BOMs (`\u{FEFF}`), `LF`/`CRLF` line endings, closing delimiter styles (`---` vs `...` for YAML, `+++` for TOML), trailing newline presence, and untouched body slices verbatim.
- **Lossless TOML Edits:** Mutates TOML frontmatter through `toml_edit::DocumentMut` so comments, inline comments, spacing, and key ordering survive edits.
- **YAML & TOML Parity:** Supports dot-separated key paths (e.g., `author.name`, `meta.seo.title`) across both YAML and TOML frontmatter blocks.
- **Rich Filtering (`--where`):** Recursive-descent expression parser supporting comparison operators, `contains` (strings and arrays), logical combinators (`and`/`&&`, `or`/`||`, `not`/`!`), parentheses, dot paths, and truthiness checks.
- **Pure-Rust Multi-Arch Portability:** Uses `jsonschema` with `default-features = false` and avoids native TLS/C dependencies so static/musl and ARM `cross` builds succeed cleanly.
- **Repository-Aware Walking:** Walks directories via `ignore` (respecting `.gitignore`) plus custom `ignore` globs from configuration.

---

## Architecture & Repository Layout

### Directory Structure

```text
mdfm/
├── Cargo.toml                 # Crate manifest, deps, release/ci profiles, cargo-deb metadata
├── Taskfile.yml               # Task runner automation (check, test, fmt, lint, build, coverage, release)
├── build.rs                   # Compile-time git describe version injection (PROJECT_VERSION)
├── AGENTS.md                  # Agent development conventions, tool rules, and quality gates
├── llms.txt                   # Concise llmstxt.org index
├── llms-full.txt              # Compiled full-context documentation (this file)
├── LICENSE                    # Apache License 2.0
├── assets/
│   ├── config.example.toml    # Annotated example configuration file
│   └── mdfm.1                 # Generated UNIX roff man page
├── completions/               # Pre-generated bash, zsh, fish, powershell, elvish completions
├── docs/                      # Zensical documentation site (index, about, installation, usage, configuration, security, CONTRIBUTING, CODE_OF_CONDUCT, README)
├── zensical.toml              # Zensical static site configuration
├── pyproject.toml             # Python / uv environment for Zensical
├── scripts/
│   ├── release.sh             # Version bump, validation, tagging, and atomic push
│   └── release_summary.py     # Categorized GitHub release notes generator
├── .github/
│   └── workflows/
│       ├── ci.yml             # Multi-OS/arch tests, rustfmt, clippy, rumdl, taplo, Coveralls
│       ├── docs.yml           # Zensical build and GitHub Pages deploy
│       └── release.yml        # Multi-arch archives, .deb apt publish, Homebrew & Scoop dispatches
├── src/
│   ├── main.rs                # Thin binary wrapper calling mdfm::run()
│   ├── lib.rs                 # Library exports and CLI dispatch (run, run_app)
│   ├── cli.rs                 # clap derive/env definitions (get, set, del, check, completions, man, update)
│   ├── config.rs              # Layered configuration resolver and local .mdfm.toml discovery
│   ├── frontmatter/
│   │   ├── mod.rs             # Zero-copy byte-offset splitter, renderer, FrontmatterData enum
│   │   ├── yaml.rs            # YAML dot-path get/set/del helpers (serde_yaml_ng)
│   │   ├── toml.rs            # Lossless TOML dot-path get/set/del helpers (toml_edit)
│   │   └── filter.rs          # --where expression lexer, parser, and evaluator
│   └── commands/
│       ├── mod.rs             # Shared .gitignore-aware file walker and output formatters
│       ├── get.rs             # get subcommand handler
│       ├── set.rs             # set subcommand handler (--dry-run, typed CLI value parser)
│       ├── del.rs             # del subcommand handler (--dry-run)
│       ├── check.rs           # check JSON Schema validation subcommand handler
│       └── update.rs          # update GitHub release self-updater (--check, -y, --version)
└── tests/
    ├── cli.rs                 # End-to-end CLI and CRLF preservation integration tests
    └── fixtures/              # Sample YAML, TOML, invalid, body-only Markdown & JSON Schema
```

### Technology Stack

- **Language & Edition:** Rust (Edition 2021)
- **CLI Parsing:** `clap` 4.5 (`derive`, `env`), `clap_complete` 4.5, `clap_mangen` 0.3
- **Frontmatter & Serialization:** `toml_edit` 0.22, `toml` 0.8, `serde` 1.0, `serde_json` 1.0, `serde_yaml_ng` 0.10
- **Directory Walking:** `ignore` 0.4
- **Schema Validation:** `jsonschema` 0.29 (`default-features = false`)
- **Self-Update:** `self_update` 1.3 (`ureq`, `rustls`, `github`, tar/zip, checksums)
- **Terminal Output:** `comfy-table` 7.1, `owo-colors` 4.2 (`supports-colors`)
- **Error Handling:** `thiserror` 2.0, `anyhow` 1.0
- **Testing:** `assert_cmd` 2.0, `predicates` 3.1, `tempfile` 3.16
- **Build Profiles:**
  - `[profile.release]`: `opt-level = "z"`, `lto = true`, `codegen-units = 1`, `panic = "abort"`, `strip = true`
  - `[profile.ci]`: `inherits = "dev"`, `incremental = false`, `debug = 0`

## Installation & Building

### Package Managers & Source

```bash
# Homebrew (macOS / Linux)
brew install nicholaswilde/homebrew-tap/mdfm

# Cargo (from source)
cargo install --git https://github.com/nicholaswilde/mdfm
```

```powershell
# Scoop (Windows)
scoop bucket add nicholaswilde https://github.com/nicholaswilde/scoop-bucket
scoop install nicholaswilde/mdfm
```

### Release Targets

Automated release builds target 8 platforms:
- Linux musl: `x86_64-unknown-linux-musl`, `aarch64-unknown-linux-musl`, `armv7-unknown-linux-musleabihf`, `arm-unknown-linux-musleabi` (plus `.deb` packages via `cargo-deb`)
- macOS: `x86_64-apple-darwin`, `aarch64-apple-darwin`
- Windows: `x86_64-pc-windows-msvc`, `i686-pc-windows-msvc`

## CLI Commands & Usage

```text
Usage: mdfm [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>
```

### Global Options

| Flag | Env Var | Values / Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--format <FORMAT>` | `MDFM_FORMAT` | `yaml` (default), `toml` | Frontmatter format used when creating frontmatter on files without any |
| `--output <OUTPUT>` | `MDFM_OUTPUT` | `table` (default), `json`, `plain`, `files` | Output presentation format |
| `-l, --files-only` | — | `false` | Print only matching file paths, one per line (shorthand for `--output files`) |
| `--where <EXPR>` | — | Filter expression | Filter target files by frontmatter predicate before running command |
| `-C, --config <PATH>` | `MDFM_CONFIG` | File path | Explicit configuration file override (TOML, YAML, or JSON) |
| `--ext <EXT>` | — | `md,markdown` | File extensions discovered during directory walks (repeatable or comma-separated) |
| `-h, --help` | — | — | Print help |
| `-V, --version` | — | — | Print version (`PROJECT_VERSION` from git describe) |

### `mdfm get [-k|--key <KEY>]... [<KEY>] [PATHS]...`

Query one or more frontmatter keys (dot paths, comma-separated `title,tags`, repeatable `-k`/`--key`) or dump the full frontmatter object with `.`. Defaults to `.` for paths when omitted.

- **`table`:** Two-column table (`File`, `<key>` or `Frontmatter`) or multi-column table (`File`, `<k1>`, `<k2>`, ...).
- **`json`:** Single/root emits `[{ "file": "...", "key": "...", "value": ... }]`; multi-key emits `[{ "file": "...", "values": { ... } }]`.
- **`plain`:** Single explicit file prints tab-delimited values (or raw JSON object for `.`); multiple files/dir prefix with `<file>\t`.
- **`files` (`-l` / `--files-only`):** Matching file paths, one per line.

```bash
# Single, multi-key, and full frontmatter queries
mdfm --output plain get author.name posts/hello.md
mdfm get title,tags docs/
mdfm get -k title -k tags docs/
mdfm --output json get . posts/ | jq '.[].value'
mdfm --where 'not has_frontmatter' -l get . docs/
```

### `mdfm set [--dry-run] [--diff] <KEY=VALUE [PATHS...]>...`

Update or insert frontmatter keys across Markdown files. Creates frontmatter using `default_format` (`yaml` or `toml`) if a target file has none.

- **`--dry-run`:** Preview changes (`would update (dry-run)`) without modifying files on disk.
- **`--diff`:** Emit unified diffs of frontmatter changes (zero output for unchanged files in `table`/`plain`; adds `"diff"` field in `json`).
- **Argument partitioning:** Arguments containing `=` (with non-empty key) are parsed as `KEY=VALUE` assignments; remaining arguments are target file/directory paths (defaults to `.`).
- **Typed value parsing (`parse_cli_value`):**
  - Booleans: `true`, `false`
  - Null: `null`
  - Integers & finite floats: `42`, `-7`, `2.5` (special non-finite strings like `inf`/`nan` stay strings)
  - JSON literals starting with `[`, `{`, or `"`: arrays (`["rust","cli"]`), objects (`{"a":1}`), explicit quoted strings (`"1.0"`)
  - Fallback: raw string (`Hello World`)

```bash
# Preview changes first
mdfm set draft=false 'tags=["rust","cli"]' weight=42 posts/ --dry-run

# Apply updates
mdfm set draft=false author.name=Nicholas posts/

# Create TOML frontmatter on files without frontmatter
mdfm --format toml set title=Created draft=false notes/plain.md
```

### `mdfm del [--dry-run] [--diff] <KEY [PATHS...]>...`

Delete one or more frontmatter keys (including nested dot paths).

- **`--dry-run`:** Preview deletions without writing to disk.
- **`--diff`:** Emit unified diffs of frontmatter deletions.
- **Argument partitioning:** First positional argument is always a key; subsequent arguments are treated as keys until a path-like token (`.`, `..`, containing `/` or `\`, matching a configured extension such as `.md`/`.markdown`, or existing on disk) begins the target paths list (defaults to `.`).

```bash
mdfm del draft author.bio posts/ --dry-run --diff
mdfm del draft legacy_id posts/
```

### `mdfm mv <OLD_KEY> <NEW_KEY> [PATHS]...` (alias: `rename`)

Atomically rename or merge a frontmatter key across YAML and TOML files (supports `--merge`, `--overwrite`, `--dry-run`, `--diff`, `--where`, `--output`).

- Errors if `<NEW_KEY>` already exists unless `--merge` or `--overwrite` is passed.
- `--merge` deduplicates arrays and shallow-merges mappings.

```bash
mdfm mv --merge tag tags docs/
mdfm rename author.full_name author.name docs/ --dry-run --diff
```

### `mdfm check [--schema <SCHEMA>] [-q|--errors-only|--quiet] [PATHS]...`

Validate frontmatter of discovered files against a JSON Schema file (`--schema`, `MDFM_SCHEMA`, or `schema` in config).

- Exits `0` when all matched files validate cleanly.
- Exits non-zero with file-level validation error details (`ok` / `fail` in `table`, structured objects in `json`, `<file>\terror: ...` in `plain`) when any file fails parsing or schema validation.
- With `-q` / `--errors-only` / `--quiet` (or `errors_only = true` in `.mdfm.toml`): hides passing entries, prints `<ok> ok, <failed> failed` in `table`/`plain` modes, and emits only failing entries (`[]` when all pass) in `json` mode.

```bash
mdfm check --schema .mdfm-schema.json posts/
mdfm check --errors-only --schema .mdfm-schema.json posts/
mdfm --output json check --errors-only --schema schema.json docs/
```

### `mdfm completions <SHELL>`

Generate shell completion scripts (`bash`, `zsh`, `fish`, `powershell`, `elvish`) to stdout.

### `mdfm man`

Render UNIX roff man page to stdout (`mdfm man > assets/mdfm.1`).

### `mdfm update [--check] [-y|--yes] [--version <VERSION>]`

Check for or install releases directly from `nicholaswilde/mdfm` GitHub Releases (pure-Rust `ureq` + `rustls`, skips `.sha256`/`.deb`, verifies non-interactive TTY confirmation).

---

## Filter Expressions (`--where`)

Implemented in `src/frontmatter/filter.rs` as a recursive-descent parser evaluated against each file's frontmatter JSON representation.

### Supported Syntax

- **Key paths:** Bare identifiers with `.` / `-` / `_` (e.g., `draft`, `author.name`, `meta.word-count`).
- **Truthiness shorthand:** Bare key path (e.g., `--where 'draft'`) evaluates truthiness (non-null, `true`, non-zero number, non-empty string/array/object).
- **Comparison operators:** `==`, `!=`, `>`, `>=`, `<`, `<=` (supports integer/float numeric comparisons and string comparisons).
- **Containment (`contains` / `CONTAINS`):**
  - On arrays: checks element equality (`tags contains "rust"`).
  - On strings: checks substring match (`title contains "Frontmatter"`).
- **Logical operators & grouping:**
  - `not` / `NOT` / `!` (highest precedence)
  - `and` / `AND` / `&&`
  - `or` / `OR` / `||` (lowest precedence)
  - Parentheses `(...)` for explicit grouping
- **Document metadata predicates:** `has_frontmatter` (`true`/`false`) and `frontmatter_format` (`"yaml"`, `"toml"`, or `null`) distinguish body-only files from empty frontmatter blocks; quote `"has_frontmatter"` to query a literal key of the same name.
- **Literals:** Quoted strings (`"..."` or `'...'` with escape handling), booleans (`true`, `false`), `null`, integers, floats.

### Examples

```bash
mdfm --where 'draft == true' get title posts/
mdfm --where 'author.name == "Nick" and tags contains "rust"' get title posts/
mdfm --where '(draft == false or weight >= 10) and not (author.name == "Bob")' get title posts/
```

---

## Configuration Reference

`mdfm` resolves settings in strict precedence order (highest to lowest):

1. **CLI flags:** `--format`, `--output`, `--schema`, `--ext`, `--errors-only` / `-q` / `--quiet`, `-C`/`--config`
2. **Environment variables:** `MDFM_FORMAT`, `MDFM_OUTPUT`, `MDFM_SCHEMA`, `MDFM_CONFIG`
3. **Explicit config or project-local `.mdfm.toml`:** Walks upward from the current working directory to find `.mdfm.toml` (unless overridden by `--config` / `MDFM_CONFIG`, which supports TOML, YAML, or JSON).
4. **User global config:**
   - Linux/macOS: `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/mdfm/config.{toml,yaml,yml,json}` (fallback `~/.config/mdfm/config.*`)
   - Windows: `%APPDATA%\mdfm\config.{toml,yaml,yml,json}`
5. **Built-in defaults:** `default_format = "yaml"`, `output = "table"`, `schema = None`, `ignore = []`, `extensions = ["md", "markdown"]`, `errors_only = false`

### Example `.mdfm.toml`

```toml
# Default frontmatter format when creating new frontmatter on files without any.
# Supported values: "yaml" (default), "toml"
default_format = "yaml"

# Output format for command results.
# Supported values: "table" (default), "json", "plain"
output = "table"

# Default JSON Schema path for `mdfm check`.
schema = ".mdfm-schema.json"

# Glob patterns to exclude when walking directories (in addition to .gitignore).
ignore = ["drafts/**", "CHANGELOG.md"]

# File extensions discovered during directory walks.
extensions = ["md", "markdown"]

# Only show validation failures and a compact summary line in `mdfm check`.
errors_only = false

# Per-glob JSON Schemas for `mdfm check` (ordered; falls back to top-level `schema`).
[[schemas]]
pattern = "docs/reference/**"
schema = ".mdfm-reference-schema.json"
```

---

## Frontmatter Engine & Preservation Guarantees

- **Zero-Copy Splitting (`src/frontmatter/mod.rs`):**
  - Detects and strips leading UTF-8 BOM (`\u{FEFF}`) before parsing, re-emitting it on render.
  - Detects document line ending (`LF` vs `CRLF`) from the first `\n` byte and normalizes rendered frontmatter lines to match.
  - Recognizes YAML opening `---` (closing `---` or `...`) and TOML opening `+++` (closing `+++`).
  - Treats unclosed `---` horizontal rules as body-only documents without frontmatter.
  - Keeps `body: &'a str` as an untouched slice of the original input string; rendering concatenates BOM + delimiters + normalized frontmatter + verbatim `body`.
- **YAML Handling (`src/frontmatter/yaml.rs`):** Parses into `serde_yaml_ng::Mapping`, supports nested dot-path get/set/del, empty/comment-only blocks parse cleanly as empty mappings.
- **TOML Handling (`src/frontmatter/toml.rs`):** Parses into `toml_edit::DocumentMut` for lossless dot-path mutation across standard and inline tables.
- **File Discovery (`src/commands/mod.rs`):** Collects files matching configured `extensions` (default `.md` and `.markdown`, case-insensitive) deterministically (sorted paths), respecting `.gitignore` via `ignore::WalkBuilder` and config `ignore` globs.

## Development, Testing & Quality Gates

### Taskfile Commands (`Taskfile.yml`)

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `task check` | Run `cargo check` |
| `task test` | Run `fmt:check`, `lint`, `cargo test`, and `clippy` |
| `task test:ci` | Run full test suite using `[profile.ci]` |
| `task fmt` / `task fmt:check` | Format / verify Rust formatting (`cargo fmt --all`) |
| `task clippy` | Run `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` |
| `task lint:md` / `task fmt:md` | Lint / format Markdown via `rumdl` |
| `task lint:toml` / `task fmt:toml` | Lint / format TOML via `taplo` |
| `task completions` / `task man` | Regenerate `completions/*` and `assets/mdfm.1` |
| `task serve` / `task docs:build` | Serve or build static Zensical site via `uv run` |
| `task build:debug` / `task build:local` | Build debug or local release binary |
| `task build` | Cross-compile `amd64`, `arm64`, `armv7`, `armv6` via `cross` |
| `task coverage` / `task coverage:report` | Generate coverage summary or `lcov.info` via `cargo-llvm-cov` |
| `task release` | Version bump, validate, tag, and push (`scripts/release.sh`) |
| `task release:summary` | Generate categorized GitHub release notes (`scripts/release_summary.py`) |

### Mandatory Quality Gates

1. `task check` passes.
2. `task fmt:check` passes.
3. `task clippy` passes with zero warnings (`-D warnings`).
4. `task test` passes all unit and integration tests (including cross-compilation child-binary preflight guard and CRLF preservation tests).
5. `task lint:md` (`rumdl check .`) passes.

### CI Matrix (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`)

Runs on push/PR to `main`:
- Tests on `ubuntu-latest` (`stable`, `beta`, `nightly`), `macos-latest` (`stable`), `windows-latest` (`stable`), and Linux ARM cross targets (`aarch64`, `armv7`, `armv6`).
- Standalone `rustfmt`, `clippy`, `markdownlint` (`rumdl`), and `coveralls` (`cargo-llvm-cov`) jobs.
